&nbsp;Job Position: Sales Leader

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

	We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sales Leader to lead the development of new business opportunities across technical, engineering and industrial markets.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for breaking into new markets, identifying high-value technical sales opportunities, building strategic relationships and converting opportunities into profitable business.
	We are looking for a hunter, not just an account manager, someone who can identify opportunities, open doors, engage decision-makers and close complex B2B deals.

	Develop and execute strategies for growing technical sales and business development.
	Identify and pursue new markets, customers and revenue opportunities.
	Prospect and build relationships with corporate, industrial, engineering, procurement and technical decision-makers.
	Sell technical products, machinery, equipment, components, engineering solutions and related services.
	Understand customer requirements and develop appropriate technical/commercial solutions.
	Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and proposal development to negotiation and closing.
	Identify tenders, RFQs, procurement opportunities and strategic projects.
	Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline and provide accurate sales forecasts.
	Build strategic relationships with OEMs, manufacturers, distributors and other technical partners.
	Lead, mentor and develop the technical sales team as the business grows.
	Provide management with market intelligence, sales reports and recommendations for growth.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Marketing, Sales or a related field.

	Proven track record of winning new business and meeting/exceeding sales targets.
	Experience selling machinery, mechanical equipment, industrial/technical products, engineering solutions or other complex B2B products / services.
	Strong experience in business development, prospecting and consultative/solution-based selling.
	Strong commercial negotiation and deal-closing skills.
	Ability to engage confidently with technical teams, procurement professionals and senior executives.
	Existing industry contacts and knowledge of the Nigerian B2B market will be an advantage.
	Experience with CRM and sales pipeline management.
	Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.


What We Are Looking For:


	Candidates should be able to demonstrate measurable achievements such as major contracts won, new accounts acquired, revenue generated, markets developed or significant technical products / equipment sold.

With decades of combined industry expertise across aircraft engineering and related technical fields, the company provides reliable solutions and support to clients across commercial and business aviation and other specialised technical sectors.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Leader

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sales Leader to lead the development of new business opportunities across technical, engineering and industrial markets.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for breaking into new markets, identifying high-value technical sales opportunities, building strategic relationships and converting opportunities into profitable business.
	We are looking for a hunter, not just an account manager, someone who can identify opportunities, open doors, engage decision-makers and close complex B2B deals.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute strategies for growing technical sales and business development.
	Identify and pursue new markets, customers and revenue opportunities.
	Prospect and build relationships with corporate, industrial, engineering, procurement and technical decision-makers.
	Sell technical products, machinery, equipment, components, engineering solutions and related services.
	Understand customer requirements and develop appropriate technical/commercial solutions.
	Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and proposal development to negotiation and closing.
	Identify tenders, RFQs, procurement opportunities and strategic projects.
	Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline and provide accurate sales forecasts.
	Build strategic relationships with OEMs, manufacturers, distributors and other technical partners.
	Lead, mentor and develop the technical sales team as the business grows.
	Provide management with market intelligence, sales reports and recommendations for growth.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Marketing, Sales or a related field.
	Minimum of 7 years of verifiable experience in technical, industrial, engineering, technology or equipment sales.
	Proven track record of winning new business and meeting/exceeding sales targets.
	Experience selling machinery, mechanical equipment, industrial/technical products, engineering solutions or other complex B2B products / services.
	Strong experience in business development, prospecting and consultative/solution-based selling.
	Strong commercial negotiation and deal-closing skills.
	Ability to engage confidently with technical teams, procurement professionals and senior executives.
	Existing industry contacts and knowledge of the Nigerian B2B market will be an advantage.
	Experience with CRM and sales pipeline management.
	Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.

	Candidates should be able to demonstrate measurable achievements such as major contracts won, new accounts acquired, revenue generated, markets developed or significant technical products / equipment sold.

Graphic Designer — Marketing Job at Astria Learning




        
    

        
        Astria Learning is an edtech company that partners with universities and institutions to deliver digital learning solutions — from online program development and learning management platforms to digital libraries and student enrollment services. Our mission is to help institutions expand access to quality education at scale.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Graphic Designer — Marketing

Job Location: Remote

Summary
     

            
    




	In this role, you will craft compelling visual assets that reinforce our brand identity across digital and print channels — from social media campaigns and partner collateral to event signage and email graphics
	You will work closely with marketing stakeholders and business partners to translate briefs into polished, on-brand design work delivered on time and to specification


What you'll do


	Design digital marketing assets including social media creatives, ad banners, email visuals, landing page graphics, and campaign toolkits.
	Produce partner and sales collateral such as presentations, one-pagers, brochures, flyers, posters, and branded templates.
	Prepare print-ready materials for events and expos — banners, roll-ups, signage, and handouts — with correct specifications (bleed, formats, and exports).
	Maintain consistent brand application across all outputs: colors, typography, layout, and logo usage.
	Support basic visual updates for website and eCommerce properties (banners, section graphics, product visuals) as needed.
	Organize and manage design files, templates, and brand assets to ensure easy reuse and version control.
	Collaborate with marketing teammates and stakeholders to interpret briefs, present concepts, incorporate feedback, and meet deadlines.


What we're looking for


	Bachelor's Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
	3–5 years of professional graphic design experience, ideally within a marketing or brand environment.
	Strong proficiency in Canva and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
	Good working knowledge of Figma for shared assets and collaborative templates.
	Solid grounding in branding principles, typography, composition, and visual storytelling.
	Demonstrated experience producing both digital and print deliverables, including pre-press and export standards.
	Strong communication skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.


Nice to have:


	Basic motion graphics skills — simple animations for social media or digital advertising.
	Familiarity with WordPress or Shopify environments when coordinating implementation of visual assets with development teams.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Human Resources & Administration Manager",
  "description": "DreamCity Property &amp; Investment Limited stands at the forefront of residential and commercial real estate development and investment across Nigeria&#39;s major urban centers. We are dedicated to delivering dependable structures supported by qualified infrastructure, premium luxury apartments in high-demand districts, and commercial properties that generate robust returns for our investors. Our continued success is built on a foundation of trust and partnership with our investors, who have become integral to our growth story.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Human Resources &amp; Administration&nbsp;Manager
Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time &amp; On-site

Position Overview


	We are looking for a seasoned Human Resources &amp; Administration Manager with a minimum of 5 years of combined experience in HR and administrative roles, specifically within the real estate and property construction industry.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing HR strategies, managing administrative operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a positive organizational culture that aligns with our business objectives.


Key Responsibilities


	Implement HR strategies, policies, and programs to align with organizational objectives and industry best practices at the Lagos region
	Oversee the end-to-end recruitment, selection, and onboarding processes for new hires, including conducting rigorous background checks and verifying credentials to ensure candidate suitability.
	Manage employee relations, performance evaluation systems, training initiatives, and career development programs to enhance workforce capabilities.
	Lead all administrative functions, including office management, facilities oversight, asset management, and vendor relations.
	Ensure strict compliance with Nigerian labor laws, regulations, and company policies in all HR and administrative practices.
	Handle employee grievances, conflict resolution, and disciplinary actions in a fair, impartial, and legally compliant manner.
